intro: Professionals and everyday users convert troy ounces (oz t) to grams (g) when working across other and metric standards in engineering specifications, international trade documentation, and technical measurements. One troy ounce equals 31.103477 grams, while 1 gram equals 0.032151 troy ounces. Whether you are verifying mass & weight specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Avoirdupois Ounces (oz) vs. Precious Metal Troy Ounces (oz t) vs. Fluid Ounces (fl oz)
items: Standard grocery and postal scales use the Avoirdupois ounce (1 oz = 28.349523125 g). Gold, silver, and platinum bullion use the Troy ounce (1 oz t = 31.1034768 g), which is 9.7% heavier.
Never confuse dry weight ounces (oz) with liquid volume fluid ounces (fl oz); they only match numerically for pure water at standard density.

faqs.question: How many grams (g) are in 1 troy ounce (oz t)?
faqs.answer: There are 31.1034768 grams (g) in 1 troy ounce (oz t), which rounds to 31.1035 g for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 gram equals 0.032151 troy ounces.

faqs.question: How do I convert troy ounces to grams (oz t to g)?
faqs.answer: To convert troy ounces to grams, use the formula: g = oz t × 31.1034768. For example, converting 10 oz t gives 311.0348 g.

faqs.question: What is 10 troy ounces in grams?
faqs.answer: 10 troy ounces (oz t) equals exactly 311.0348 grams (g) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
